font_family.description: The specific font family name for Khmer OS Bokor.

default_family.description: The default generic font family to map to Khmer OS Bokor.

locale_code.description: The locale/language code (e.g., km for Khmer) for which the override applies.

match_family.description: The font family name used in the match test condition.

edit_family.description: The font family name to prepend when the match conditions are met.
